Page (stephabegg.com Pickets) has Pyramid reached via Goodell Creek and Crescent Creek Basin, but nothing about this East Ridge specifically; peak-level inference only, same as prior pass. Goodell Creek is the only Southern Pickets approach found, so likely but not established for this route.

Lead still Snow Lakes Trailhead (WTA 47.5441,-120.7097 opened; USFS 47.544106,-120.709515), via Nada Lake 5.2 mi, per search results for the Mountaineers West Side page; both Mountaineers pages return 403 so no opened page ties this route. WTA Snow Lakes page does not mention Temple. Weak.

identifiedBy.fact: Bob Burd trip report: Roads End, Bubbs Creek trail, East Lake, Lake Reflection, pass south, east ridge to summit

placements.name: Bubbs Creek, Woods Creek, and Rae Lakes

notes: Upgraded from inferred: a trip report of this exact line (pass then east ridge) starts at Roads End. Placements ~150 m apart; Cedar Grove point is the general area.

Ted Muller page: standard PCT trailheads are Donner Summit (7 mi) and Squaw Valley (8 mi); other starts are Coldstream and Truckee forest roads. Nothing ties the route's 'reach the PCT' to one. Several equal starts; leave unpinned.

identifiedBy.fact: Trinity Peak West Ridge (class 4) page lists Molas Pass - Elk Park Trailhead, 10630 ft; route text says Vestal Basin

notes: Coordinate converted from printed 37 44 52.44 N, 107 41 19.63 W. Alternate Needleton/Elk Park by train exists. Long backpack (about 18 mi approach).

Searches show Marvin Pass/Horse Corral, Shepherd Pass/Symmes Creek and Roads End all used; no page names one as the standard route. Wikipedia: easiest is East Ridge or SW face class 2. Sierra Peaks page had no route text.
Two equal class 2 approaches: George Creek (east, shortest, no signed trailhead) and Shepherd Pass. Sierra Club ratings list both. SummitPost not opened. Stays stuck.
